roles.name: ci
roles.title: CI runner
roles.summary: Runs GitHub Actions jobs for private repositories on ephemeral runner slots.

roles.name: web
roles.title: Web server
roles.summary: Retired 2026-10-26: every application is hosted on Railway. Its Vault role token and age key stay until a reviewed vault plan removes them.

roles.name: cache
roles.title: Attic binary cache
roles.summary: Retired 2026-10-26: nodes use the cloud cache at cache.example.com/nix. Its Vault role token and age key stay until a reviewed vault plan removes them.

roles.name: netboot
roles.title: Network boot server
roles.summary: Retired 2026-10-26: it never served an installer that could finish. Reinstall with fleet-node on the machine. Its Vault role token and age key stay until a reviewed vault plan removes them.

roles.name: devbox
roles.title: Development box
roles.summary: One developer works on applications over SSH. No runner units or CI credentials.
